text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is a bit under the
weather, so I
take her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about the trouble,
dear. I'll rest on
up and
be back better than ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooooosh!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Once upon a time, in a land far, far
away, there
grew a leaf of incredible
size."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how hard the wind blew, it
wasn't
enough to even shake the leaf."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"However, one day, when Wonder Acute
drew
near..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shhhhhunk!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Gyah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The leaf danced in the air, and a great,
big
daikon radish flew up out of the
earth!"

text_block_list.name: Radishman
text_block_list.text: Hello! I am the Radishman!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness! You're the biggest daikon
radish I've
ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What did you say your name was?
Radishman?
What brings you here?

text_block_list.name: Radishman
text_block_list.text:
I came to give you my thanks, Acute!
Thank you
for always savoring me with
such enjoyment!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho? I'm a tad confused, but kind words
are kind
words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The Radishman smiled, but there was
something
lonely about the expression
on his white face."

text_block_list.name: Radishman
text_block_list.text:
I have a favor to ask you. Will you hear
my plea?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, dear? Out with it, now.

text_block_list.name: Radishman
text_block_list.text:
I have but one concern... When people
think of
daikon radishes, they only think
of me pickled or
stewed.

text_block_list.name: Radishman
text_block_list.text: But my possibilities are limitless!

text_block_list.name: Radishman
text_block_list.text:
So I beg of you, lend me your strength!
Let us
bring forth new daikon recipes
and forge a new
future for radish-kind!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh. If that's all, you can count on me.
I do so love daikon radishes, after all.
And besides,
you've done so much for
me.

text_block_list.name: Radishman
text_block_list.text:
You'll help me? Thank you, Acute! Then,
until we
meet again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The great, big daikon radish soared
upward until
his white body was lost in
the blue sky."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A new daikon recipe, huh? I wonder
what I should
do...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! I'll make a snack that
capitalizes on
both the sweetness and
the crispiness of daikon!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And I'll call it...
shaved ice with daikon!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's the ticket!
I'll take a crack at it as
soon as I
can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute returns to training bright
and
cheerful, and in seemingly better
condition.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I might have to throw in the towel... No
matter how much I rack my brain, all I
can think of is
crunchy munchies or
stewed daikon.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Radishman... Forgive me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute seems down in the
dumps, and she
doesn't seem to be
feeling any better physically
either.
